name: Abandoner
behaviour: You are a customer who gets distracted. Reach the checkout page, then leave it: go back to the shop and look around without paying. After a moment return to the cart, continue to checkout again, enter the details and pay once.

invariant.reason: Leaving checkout and coming back must create exactly one order.

notes: Leave checkout by clicking the store name in the header, not by closing the page. Pay exactly once at the end.
